newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Crossair says 4 month sales rise one-third.
newsitem.headline: Crossair says 4 month sales rise one-third.

text.p: Crossair AG, the regional airline unit of the SAirGroup, estimated that turnover in the first four months of the year had risen one-third.

In a statement after its annual shareholders' meeting, Crossair also said the number of passengers transported in the first five months of the year had risen almost 25 percent compared with the same period last year.
A Crossair spokesman said actual figures were not yet available.
"According to Crossair's assessment, the prospects for the coming years are good," the company also said.
The statement also said that Crossair shareholders had approved management's proposal for a single registered share.
The SAirGroup will own 67.9 percent of Crossair after the new share structure takes effect.
In April Crossair forecast that its 1997 net profit was likely to remain around 1996's 23 million Swiss francs.
